description: This file defines a handler class for processing delete commands related to collateral entities in the Fineract platform. It implements command handling logic for deleting collateral records by invoking the collateral write service.

classes.name: DeleteCollateralCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to delete collateral, annotated with command type metadata and transactional behavior.

methods.name: DeleteCollateralCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the collateral write service. Uses dependency injection to initialize the service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete collateral command by calling the collateral write service to perform deletion.
